notes.title: 🛠️Updates & Fixes #4
notes.content:
[b]Update #4 Now Live[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Bug Fix:[/b] Resolved an issue where players could not exit a dustbin while the basketball ability was active.
[*] [b]Level Design Adjustment:[/b] Blocked off a section on Floor 3 to prevent players from entering unintended areas. This makes progression more linear and reduces confusion.
[*] [b]Additional Hints:[/b] Added more in-game hints to better guide players through key moments.
[*] [b]New Cutscene:[/b] A new cutscene has been added after the boss fight (Good Ending) to deliver a more satisfying conclusion.

[/list]
More minor fixes and tweaks will follow in the coming days and weeks.

Thank you for your continued support and patience.

notes.title: An update on Scarred from The Iterative Collective
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm Matthew, CEO of The Iterative Collective, the publisher of [b][i]Scarred[/i][/b].

I want to personally apologize for the rough launch and the frustration many of you have experienced. We know you expected more, and we should have delivered better.

[i]Scarred[/i] was developed by KOEX Studio, a solo indie developer who has poured an incredible amount of time, effort, and heart into creating this game over the last 3 years. As the publisher, it was our role to support that vision and make sure the final release met the quality bar players deserve. On that front, we fell short. Our QA and testing processes were not thorough enough, and we take full responsibility for that.

At the same time, we’ve had honest conversations with KOEX Studio, and we both acknowledge that more time should have been taken. The decision to move ahead with the release was a shared one. In hindsight, it would have been better to delay and put the game through a more rigorous QA process.

KOEX Studio built something truly unique with [i]Scarred[/i], and it’s on us to help polish and support it properly. We are now working closely with KOEX to address the major issues, including:

[list]
[*] [b]Crash and stability fixes[/b]
[*] [b]Gameplay progression blockers.[/b]
[*] [b]Improving Audio and sound design[/b]
[*] [b]Performance optimizations[/b]
[/list]

Patches are already underway, and we’ll be pushing out updates as quickly and safely as possible. We'll also communicate more frequently to keep you informed on progress.

Thank you for your patience and for giving your feedback. It’s helping us build a much better experience. And most importantly, thank you for supporting solo indie developers like KOEX Studio. They deserve it.

We’re committed to doing right by both the players and by KOEX Studio.

Matthew Quek
CEO | The Iterative Collective

notes.title: 🛠️ Scarred – First Patch & Update on Known Issues
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

First off, thank you to everyone who's played Scarred and taken the time to share feedback. As a solo developer, I deeply appreciate your support and honesty.

I've been closely monitoring your reports and have already released an update addressing several key issues:

✅ Patch Notes
[list]
[*] Mouse Sensitivity: Adjusted for smoother control.
[*] Final Level Difficulty: Reduced to enhance playability.
[*] Unable to Exit Note Viewing: Fixed by adding a new button to exit.
[*] Item Collection Bug: Resolved the issue causing players to get stuck.
[*] Diary Interaction: Fixed so you can no longer interact with the world while the diary is open.
[*] Barrel Tutorial: Added guidance for pushing barrels.
[/list]

I understand there are still bugs and areas needing improvement. Please know that I'm actively working on these, but as a solo developer, it may take some time. Your patience and continued feedback are invaluable during this process.

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to reach out via the Steam Community Hub or the in-game feedback option.

Thank you for being part of this journey.

— KOEX Studio

This game is a passion project from a solo developer, and we’re incredibly excited (and terrified) to share it with you.

notes.title: Scarred Delayed to April 17th, But Steam Next Fest Demo is Out Now!
notes.content:
Dear Community,

We have both exciting news and a small update to share about Scarred's development journey.

First, we want to announce that Scarred will be moving its release date to [b]April 17th, 2025[/b]. While we know this might disappoint some of you who were looking forward to our March 6th release, this decision wasn't made lightly. These extra weeks will be dedicated to polishing our signature features and ensuring the nightmare-twisted Singapore we've created delivers the haunting experience you deserve.

But here's the exciting part - you won't have to wait until April to step into our world! 

We're thrilled to announce that Scarred will be part of this Steam Next Fest. You'll get to experience a substantial slice of our psychological horror adventure, including:

[list]
[*] 🔍 Uncover a dark mystery weaving Singaporean folklore with personal tragedy, as fragmented memories reveal the haunting final days of your missing classmate.
[*] ⏰ Navigate between present and past as you experience two intertwined timelines, each holding crucial pieces of a story that refuses to stay buried.
[*] 👻 Facing a tormented spirit in the world between the living and dead - And beware, her hatred may unleash consequences beyond your control.
[/list]
The demo will give you a taste of our innovative puzzle mechanics, the atmospheric horror we've crafted, and our unique take on Singaporean horror storytelling.


[h2]Stay Connected[/h2]
Join our community to keep up with development updates:
Developer's X/Twitter:  [url=website]https://x.com/koexstudio[/url]
Game's X/Twitter: [url=twitter]https://x.com/PlayScarred[/url]

Thank you for your patience and support. We can't wait to share this glimpse into Scarred with you during Steam Next Fest!

Best regards,
KOEX Studio
